rules.description: Caps Lock + App Switching (tap alone for Escape)
Hyper -> Magnet: arrows/UIJK halves+quarters, F center third, 1-3 thirds, 4-6 two-thirds, . , display, Return max, Delete restore, numpad 1-6 sixths
Cmd+h/j/k/l -> Ctrl in terminals (tmux/Neovim pane moves)
Hyper+[ ] -> previous/next window of this app (Shift+Cmd+` / Cmd+`)
Swap Cmd+[ ] <-> Cmd+Shift+[ ] (tabs on Cmd+[ ], old behavior on Shift)
Chat apps: same keys in Claude + ChatGPT (⌘B sidebar in ChatGPT; ⌘K search / ⇧⌘K palette in Claude)
Finder: Cmd+K -> Go to Folder (Shift+Cmd+G), the jump verb
